verdict.rationale: Browser Use is itself an agent/automation product; evidence (browser-use-docs-12) shows it ships as an MCP *server* that other clients (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) connect to, not as an MCP *client* that consumes external MCP servers' tools. Per the agent-role exception, this client-side 'plug in MCP servers' story is out of scope for a product that is itself an agent unless it explicitly runs as an MCP client, which no evidence shows.
